input.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return obligations on termination
input.comment: [Playbook] We need an orderly exit: up to six months of transition assistance and return of our and our Customers' data in machine-readable form within 30 days (fallback: 90 days' assistance). This complements, and does not cut back, the survival rights in Section 11.3.

ops.text: 11.4 Transition Assistance and Data Return. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Commerce One shall (a) at Corio's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Commerce One's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Corio's request, return to Corio all data of Corio and its Customers in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.

input.summary: Insert a Vendor insurance covenant in Section 14
input.comment: [Playbook] Vendors whose personnel work alongside ours and whose service handles transaction data should carry standard cover: CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M and cyber USD 5M (fallback: E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M). Subsequent subsections to be renumbered.

ops.text: 14.10 Insurance. Commerce One shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; and, where Commerce One processes data of Corio or its Customers, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. Commerce One shall provide certificates of insurance to Corio on request.
